fullDesc: Sega released Sonic the Hedgehog in 1991 for the Genesis, created by Yuji Naka, Naoto Ohshima and Hirokazu Yasuhara. Its speed and attitude gave Sega a mascot to compete with Nintendo's Mario.
realFacts: It was a pack-in game with the Genesis
Sega gained a large share of the US market in the early 1990s
Sonic later appeared in films and television
